gaps.description: Audit logging uses console output instead of persistent storage
gaps.impact: Audit trails are not persisted and will be lost on service restart. Cannot meet compliance requirements for audit logging.
gaps.recommendation:
Implement persistent audit log storage using either:
1. Database audit table with AuditLog entity
2. Async audit event publishing to Kafka
3. Dedicated audit service integration
4. Consider using Spring Boot Actuator audit events
dependencies: Kafka audit topic configuration (if using messaging)

gaps.description: Session metadata field is set to null with a TODO-like comment
gaps.codeSnippet: .metadata(trackingMapper instanceof TrackingMapper ? null : null) // Will be set by mapper if needed
gaps.impact: Session metadata from CreateSessionRequestDto is not being persisted. Loss of potentially important tracking context.
gaps.recommendation:
Implement proper metadata serialization:
1. Use JsonMapper to convert metadata Map to JSON string
2. Create a method in TrackingMapper: String mapToJson(Map<String, Object> metadata)
3. Set the serialized JSON in the session entity
dependencies: JsonMapper already exists in the codebase

gaps.description: Event properties and metadata are set to null instead of being serialized
gaps.codeSnippet:
.properties(null) // Will be set by mapper
.metadata(null) // Will be set by mapper
gaps.impact: Event properties and metadata from CreateEventRequestDto are not persisted. Loss of event context and custom attributes.
gaps.recommendation:
Implement properties and metadata serialization:
1. Use JsonMapper to convert properties Map to JSON string
2. Create mapper methods for both properties and metadata
3. Set the serialized JSON in the event entity
dependencies: JsonMapper already exists in the codebase

immediate.item: Fix session metadata serialization in TrackingCommandService.createSession()

immediate.item: Fix event properties/metadata serialization in TrackingCommandService.createEvent()
immediate.impact: Prevents data loss for event context
